standardized.notes: Contemporary SIGCOMM publication of algorithms implemented/tested in 4BSD TCP lineage; not a new TCP wire-version number.

roles: discover/use path capacity through ACK clocking

software.version_or_revision: 1986-1988 congestion-control work; exact source revisions pending

flow_or_congestion_control: Congestion window and slow-start/congestion-avoidance behavior organized around packet conservation and ACK clocking, alongside improved RTT/RTO behavior.

operations.monitoring: Measured throughput, loss and RTT behavior used to validate algorithms.
operations.diagnostics: Internet congestion-collapse incidents and LBL/UCB path measurements motivate implementation changes.
operations.failure_behavior: Poor sender timing/window behavior can amplify congestion and retransmission collapse.

notes: Do not conflate this artifact with the Nagle small-packet rule, ICMP Source Quench, or all later TCP congestion-control variants.
